LanguageData.Gun_Springfield_M1903A3_RWP.label: Springfield M1903A3
LanguageData.Gun_Springfield_M1903A3_RWP.description: The Springfield M1903A3 is a bolt-action rifle known for its accuracy and reliability. Preferred by marksmen, it offers a high range and precise aim, making it effective at taking down enemies from a distance. Ideal for colonists who prioritize precision over rapid fire.
